chapter: Hampton, Andy Kirk and Charlie Barnet
title: Charlie Allen makes Fats a mouthpiece
summary: McGhee takes Fats to Chicago mouthpiece maker Charlie Allen, who also made him one when his was stolen with Hampton.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Cornet or trumpet: choosing and owning horns

blocks.x: I said, "Well, I say so. You got to learn how to do it. Now, the first place we got to do is get you a mouthpiece. That mouthpiece you got is too big. It takes all your energy away and you ain't gettin' nothin' out of your horn." I said, "Now, we've got to go see this cat in Chicago. When we get to Chicago (I know we're going in Chicago, because we're going in the Regal), I'll have him make you a mouthpiece." So he said, "Yeah, man. I got to have this."

So we went to Chicago, and I took him down to meet Charlie Allen. I told him, "Charlie, Fats is having a little problem with his mouthpiece, and he can't get over high C. What can you do for him?" He said, "Leave him with me for a while; I'll try him out." I left him down there, and I split. So the next day Fats says, "I think he's going to make me a mouthpiece, man..."
Charlie Allen, yeah. He made mouthpieces. he made me one.

Yeah. Because somebody stole my mouthpiece. If it don't be for him, I would have been up shit creek, too. He made my mouthpiece for me in a day, and I... That's when I was with Lionel Hampton. I left my horn...
Oh, the two weeks at the Regal, right?

Yeah. I left my horn in the cab. And I didn't know the cab-driver was going to bring my horn back. So I went down to try to find me a mouthpiece, and I run into Charlie Allen, man. He said, "Yeah." He made me a mouthpiece practically just like the one I had. So the next day I had me a mouthpiece to play, but my horn was already there. The cat had brought it back to the theatre and said, "Here, this cat left his horn in my cab." I know that I was so glad to see the horn, I forgot all about that I went and had me a mouthpiece made. But in the meantime, I had tried that out, too, and I could use that. I said, "Well, it don't hurt to have two..."
But you knew Fats had something special.
